units.source_text: 从鞠子的谈话中，我觉得她似乎比我大一两岁。

en.t: From Mariko's way of speaking, I felt that she seemed to be a year or two older than I was.
In fact, that was exactly the case.

units.source_text: 乳房就在我紧跟前渗出了汗珠子。

en.t: Her breasts, right there in front of me, had begun to bead with sweat.

units.source_text: 它只是一种肉体，绝对不会变形为金阁。

en.t: It was only flesh, and it would never transform into the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 我战战兢兢地用指头去触摸它。

en.t: Trembling with fear, I reached out with my fingers to touch it.
